Title: Azure Resource Graph—New join support functionality is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Resource Graph now supports join functionality, allowing for more advanced exploration of your Azure environment by enabling you to correlate between resources and their properties. Use it to retrieve richer results by combining different resource types and their properties, based on a related property between them. See sample queries.

Learn more.
